newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were stable in late trading on Wednesday with a few bids reported, traders said.

They said buyers bid at 46.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan but no deals were done. "Buyers were bidding at 46.75 in Medan for June/July shipment but there's no transaction yet. Prices are generally stable in other cities because there are no buyers," said one trader.
Traders said offer prices were stable at 46.50 fob Palembang, at 46.25 fob Padang, at 46.625 fob Surabaya and at 46.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
Traders said some dealers wanted to buy rubber for August shipment but many traders refused to sell because it would not be profitable for them when prices were still low.
"Some traders also do not want to sell much rubber for June and July shipment because they hope prices will improve soon," said one trader.
Traders said stocks were piling up as wintering ended and some believed levels could fall to 45.00 if market sentiment stayed weak.
